components.name: Exercise Card
components.description: One exercise slot: a free-text label and a 1RM field above a hairline-divided results block.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e8f0); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 6%), 0 8px 24px rgb(15 23 42 / 6%)); padding: 1rem; } .ds-card-inputs { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; align-items: flex-end; } .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; } .ds-field-1rm { flex: 0 0 7.5rem; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--muted, #64748b); }

components.name: Text / Number Field
components.description: Inset input on the Panel Mist step; azure outline on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem; font: inherit; color: var(--text, #0f172a); background: var(--surface-2, #f8fafc); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e8f0); border-radius: 9px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--accent, #2563eb); }

components.name: Segmented Pill
components.description: Unselected half of the Training Max toggle.
components.css: .ds-segment { display: inline-flex; } .ds-segment span { display: inline-block; padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e8f0); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text, #0f172a); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.85rem; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; }

components.name: Segmented Pill (Selected)
components.description: Selected Training Max segment: the system's only filled accent surface.
components.css: .ds-segment { display: inline-flex; } .ds-segment span { display: inline-block; padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e8f0); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text, #0f172a); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.85rem; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; } .ds-segment-selected span { background: var(--accent, #2563eb); border-color: var(--accent, #2563eb); color: #fff; }

components.name: Warm-up Chip
components.description: Read-only warm-up set: bold weight, muted percentage × reps.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: var(--surface-2, #f8fafc); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e8f0); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text, #0f172a); } .ds-chip small { color: var(--muted, #64748b); margin-left: 0.15rem; }

components.css: .ds-grid { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text, #0f172a); } .ds-grid th, .ds-grid td { text-align: left; padding: 0.4rem 0.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e8f0); vertical-align: top; } .ds-grid thead th { font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--muted, #64748b); font-weight: 600; } .ds-grid tbody th { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted, #64748b); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-grid tbody tr:last-child th, .ds-grid tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-weight { display: block; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-weight .ds-unit { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted, #64748b); margin-left: 0.15rem; } .ds-meta { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted, #64748b); }

components.name: Current-Week Control
components.description: Second segmented pill row (WEEK 1-4) driving every card; sticky at the top on phones.
components.css: .ds-weekbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-weekbar-label { font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--muted, #64748b); margin-right: 0.35rem; } .ds-segment { display: inline-flex; } .ds-segment span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e8f0); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text, #0f172a); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.85rem; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; } .ds-segment span:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #2563eb); } .ds-segment-selected span { background: var(--accent, #2563eb); border-color: var(--accent, #2563eb); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); }

components.css: .ds-now { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-now-set { background: var(--surface-2, #f8fafc); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e8f0); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.6rem 0.65rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-now-amrap { border-color: var(--accent, #2563eb); } .ds-now-set .ds-weight { display: block; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-now-set .ds-weight .ds-unit { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted, #64748b); margin-left: 0.15rem; } .ds-now-set .ds-meta { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted-strong, #475569); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-amrap { display: inline-block; margin-top: 0.35rem; padding: 0.12rem 0.4rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent, #2563eb); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.html:

components.css: .ds-details { margin-top: 0.9rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #e2e8f0); padding-top: 0.4rem; } .ds-details summary { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted-strong, #475569); } .ds-details summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-details summary::after { content: ''; width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; margin-left: auto; border-right: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-bottom: 1.5px solid currentColor; transform: rotate(45deg); transition: transform 150ms ease; } .ds-details[open] summary::after { transform: rotate(-135deg); } .ds-details summary:hover { color: var(--accent, #2563eb); } .ds-details summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 6px; }

narrative.overview:
This is the dry-erase board by the rack, not a training app. You walk up, read today's numbers, and walk away. The system is calm, exact, and unobtrusive: chrome stays quiet, numbers stay loud, and nothing on screen asks to be admired. Density is comfortable rather than compressed, because the reader is standing, one-handed, mid-set.

The interface is a single flat plane of cards on a cool grey ground. Depth is implied by hairline borders and one tonal step between the page, the card, and the inset fields — the card's faint shadow is a separator, not a hierarchy. One accent color, a measured blue, marks the only interactive states that matter: which Training Max percentage and which week are active, and what currently has focus.

The screen leads with now. A global current-week control drives every card; each card shows that week's three working sets at full size, with the AMRAP top set tagged, and folds the warm-up and the full four-week grid into an "All weeks & warm-up" disclosure. The flat all-weeks matrix is a reference the lifter opens, never the default view.

Everything here is instrument-like. Weights are set in tabular figures so columns align and nothing jitters as values change; labels are small, uppercase, and letter-spaced like the silkscreen on a machine; the results grid reads top-to-bottom without decoration. The system must never look like an athletic or fitness brand — no neon, no grit, no motivational energy — and equally not like a marketing dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, exact, unobtrusive; the numbers are the only loud thing.
One accent (Signal Azure), reserved for active state and focus.
Cool-slate neutrals only; no warm greys.
Flat by default; hairlines and tonal steps carry separation.
Tabular figures for every weight and percentage.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Azure appears only on the active selection, the AMRAP tag, and focus outlines. It is never used for body text, large fills, or decoration.

rules.name: The Cool Steel Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is cool and blue-leaning. No warm grey, cream, or brown-tinted surface enters the system.

rules.name: The On-Accent Rule
rules.body: Text on a filled azure surface uses the On-Accent token, never a hard-coded white; in dark mode that is near-black, so the bright azure fill stays legible.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every weight and percentage uses tabular figures — the results grid, the warm-up chips, and the now-set tiles — so digits align in columns and never reflow as values change.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest, and the card separator is the system's only shadow. It never intensifies on interaction.

dos: Do keep exactly one accent. Signal Azure is for the active segment, the AMRAP tag, and focus rings only.
Do use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for every weight and percentage.
Do keep all neutrals cool; pair Cool Paper with Ink Slate and Midnight Steel with Pale Slate.
Do separate surfaces with 1px hairlines and one tonal step before reaching for any shadow.
Do keep the current week's weights the largest, heaviest numbers on a card.
Do use the On-Accent token for any text on a filled azure surface.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue or any warm neutral.
Don't deepen or add shadows on hover or focus; express state through color and outline only.
Don't borrow athletic or fitness-brand signals — no neon, grit, gradients, or motivational energy.
Don't exceed a 14px radius on cards or reintroduce sharp corners.
Don't set weight or percentage figures in proportional (non-tabular) figures.
Don't show the full all-weeks matrix by default; the now-row leads and the matrix stays behind its disclosure.
